original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    SUM(ssc.store_cnt)::bigint AS cnt
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
 AND d1.d_year = 2001
JOIN item i
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
 AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
 AND i.i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
JOIN customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
JOIN warehouse w
  ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT s_state, COUNT(*) AS store_cnt
    FROM store
    GROUP BY s_state
) ssc
  ON ssc.s_state = w.w_state
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
 AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
 AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
 AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Rewrote implicit comma joins into explicit ANSI JOINs with filters placed in the join conditions where appropriate; this preserves semantics but avoids ambiguity and improves maintainability.

The original store join (s_state = w_state) is not connected by a store key, so it multiplies every qualifying row by the number of stores in the warehouse state. It was replaced with a pre-aggregated store count per state and SUM(store_cnt), which is equivalent for the final COUNT(*) aggregation but avoids row multiplication before grouping.
Avoided excessive CTE creation because most filters can be inlined and pushed down by the optimizer. A single derived table is used only for the store-state pre-aggregation.
The 30-day date range condition between d1 and d2 was moved into the join condition and normalized using INTERVAL '30 days' syntax.
The redundant equivalence chain ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk was simplified by joining inventory to warehouse and web_sales to the same warehouse row.
The interval expression d1.d_date + interval '30' day was rewritten as d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30 days' for clearer and more portable interval handling.
